action.Description:
The action to be performed in the default service accounts. Valid values are: DEPRIVILEGE, DELETE, DISABLE.
				Note that DEPRIVILEGE action will ignore the REVERT configuration in the restore_policy.

project.Description: The project ID where service accounts are created.

restore_policy.Description:
The action to be performed in the default service accounts on the resource destroy.
				Valid values are NONE, REVERT and REVERT_AND_IGNORE_FAILURE. It is applied for any action but in the DEPRIVILEGE.

service_accounts.Description: The Service Accounts changed by this resource. It is used for revert the action on the destroy.
